content.text: I'm working through the far-hoop contact sheets. Shot 1 sat on the rim for about 1.5 s, then fell off the front, so I'm calling it missed. I'll read the remaining sheets in batches.
Shots 1–10 are read: made on shots 2, 3, 7, 8 and 10, and missed on 1, 4, 5, 6 and 9. I'm continuing with the last sheets, from about 48 s.
Far-hoop shots are done. Next is `pass-releases`.
Passes are done: 12 releases found. Next is `stroke-rate`, starting at about 14 s.

All four tasks are answered below. Treat the first and last as rough estimates, since the juggle count and the stroke rate came from tiny thumbnails.

1. **`juggle-touches`: 60.** The red player's touches came about 2 to 2.5 a second in the sheets I read (up to 14 s), with a drop of about 1.3 s around 1.2 to 2.5 s. I skipped sheets 8–15 and extrapolated, so this is an estimate.
2. **`far-hoop-shots`: made on shots 2, 3, 7, 8, 10 and 13; missed on the other seven.** I counted 13 launches, at about 0.8, 6.0, 10.4, 15.0, 19.2, 24.7, 29.8, 34.7, 39.3, 43.5, 47.9, 53.1 and 57.7 s. I called a shot made when the ball dropped straight under the net, in line with the rim. I called it missed when the ball left the rim to the left and fell in front of it.
3. **`pass-releases`: 12 releases.** They are at about 0.76, 1.5, 3.2, 4.84, 5.5 (one-touch), 7.45, 9.0, 10.95, 12.75, 15.05, 17.05 and 18.88 s. I traced the ball's flight and worked back to the hand. The 7.45 and 12.75 s times are less certain because the red defender hid the ball.
